hypothesis: Closed-form ridge fitting of the no-propagator residual output can escape the zero-residual stationary point that defeated gradient-only meta-training on the corrected r5b parent.
mechanism: Solve the final residual map by regularized least squares on train-only high-residual spatial points, then use the fitted map as the initialization for low-dimensional per-instance optimization.
primary_metric: ridge_prefit_mean_loss on the identical 12 train episodes
failure_signal: No ridge candidate reduces paired train loss by at least 1 percent or the selected system condition number exceeds 1e8.
next_gate: Any accepted ridge checkpoint must improve group-disjoint train episodes before validation.
rollback: Reject the isolated checkpoint and retain the frozen r5b parent if the gate fails.
